reference-contract.json inventories CSSPseudoElement.selectorText and its serialization algorithm across all 9 dimensions and explicitly lists pre-existing interface members (type, element, parent, pseudo) in outOfScope with rationales.

Clearly contrasts type vs selectorText, documents single-segment sub-pseudo behavior, explains physical vs logical ::scroll-button() rules for author-created vs browser-created instances, and documents null-return and strict-mode error behavior.

Embeds verified 200 live Chrome Platform Showcase concept demo (type-vs-selectortext/) with sandbox and referrerpolicy attributes, links all 4 sibling concept demos, and provides two complete semantic <pre><code> examples (scroll-button/view-transition round-tripping and feature detection).

Zero unlinked citation labels; all external links carry target='_blank' rel='noopener'; full 16-digit ChromeStatus ID 5071155760332800.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions with aria-labelledby and 3px :focus-visible outline, iframe title attribute, and Baseline banner role='note'.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible documentation landmarks headings tables dark mode typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Place all content in semantic landmarks (<main>, <header>, <nav>, <footer>), use sequential headings, semantic tables with <caption> and <th scope>, explicit :focus-visible outlines, and aria-labelledby for named regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: single <main>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, sequential h1/h2/h3 hierarchy, captioned tables with <th scope>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions wired via aria-labelledby with :focus-visible outlines, and titled iframe.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll navigation without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use logical sizing properties (max-inline-size, inline-size), display: block on replaced elements like <iframe> to eliminate inline gaps, flex-wrap with gap, and overflow: auto rather than overflow: hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: .table-wrap uses max-inline-size: 100%, .example-embed iframe uses display: block and inline-size: 100%, and shared /public/styles.css handles flex-wrap and overflow-x: auto.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible documentation landmarks headings tables dark mode typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply text-wrap: balance to headings via shared stylesheet without applying globally; keep body and code typography readable across viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied via shared /public/styles.css (headings balanced, code blocks horizontally scrollable). Exception: omitted text-wrap: pretty on long body paragraphs to avoid unnecessary line-breaking work.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible documentation landmarks headings tables dark mode typography
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Rely on semantic color tokens adapting to light/dark color-scheme without hardcoding conflicting inline overrides.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: inherits /public/styles.css semantic tokens and light-dark variables with minimal page-specific table/embed rules.
